title: The Kerala Temporary Stay of Eviction Proceedings Act 2007
full_text: The Kerala Temporary Stay of Eviction Proceedings Act 2007 2007-ലെ കേരള ഒഴിപ്പിക്കല്‍ നടപടികള്‍ താല്‍ക്കാലിക നിര്‍ത്തിവയ്‍ക്കല്‍ ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200714 Act Number: 14 Enactment Date: 2007-08-23 Act Year: 2007 Short Title: The Kerala Temporary Stay of Eviction Proceedings Act 2007 Hindi Title: 2007-ലെ കേരള ഒഴിപ്പിക്കല്‍ നടപടികള്‍ താല്‍ക്കാലിക നിര്‍ത്തിവയ്‍ക്കല്‍ ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to provide for the stay of eviction of certain persons in occupation of the land vested in the Government, as surplus land under the Kerala Land Reforms Act 1963 (1 of 1964) situated in Raroth Village of Kozhikode Taluk of Kozhikode District, more particularly described in the Schedule for a temporary period, till final decisions on the pending applications for assignment of land under section 96 of the Kerala Land Reforms Act 1963 are taken.
